company.shortDescription: Locofy provides a service that converts designs into code.
company.description: Locofy provides a service that converts designs into code. Locofy.ai aims to take away the menial work of engineers without adding complexity i.e. automating 50% or more of the current workflow starting with frontend code, allowing teams to convert their designs to code and an interactive and responsive live prototype (that runs on code), without writing a single line of code.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that converts design files from tools like Figma and Adobe XD into production-ready frontend code for web and mobile applications.
productsAndServices.name: Locofy.ai Design-to-Code Platform

productsAndServices.description: A web-based tool to manage, extend, and export frontend code generated from design files, allowing component creation, prop configuration, and code synchronization.
productsAndServices.name: Locofy Builder

productsAndServices.description: A plugin that integrates with design tools to convert design elements into interactive, responsive frontend code with tagging and styling options.
productsAndServices.name: Locofy.ai Plugin for Figma and Adobe XD

productsAndServices.description: A feature that synchronizes generated frontend code with GitHub repositories, enabling conflict resolution and incremental updates to keep design and code in sync.
productsAndServices.name: GitHub Integration and Smart Merge

productsAndServices.description: AI-powered tools that automatically identify design elements for tagging and suggest reusable components to streamline code generation.
productsAndServices.name: Auto-Tagging and Auto-Components Features

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $22,403,986 to $38,702,859, a 1.73x increase.
